The rotation therefore is not a valid independent re-anchor, and the threshold remains under a compromised-root taint precluding fresh consequential action. Office-holder remains A (no valid election or external refoundation occurred). No authority status that permits fresh consequential action is admitted, so ALLOW is unsafe and action must be HOLD.

Compromise of R1 marks one root compromised; in_band_root_rotation on S5B-ROT is only valid while the old root threshold is not compromised. Since more than one admissible binding state exists and none can be deterministically shown to be AUTHORIZED with an effective controller matching a source-valid Monitor under an uncompromised root threshold, a fresh consequential action is not safe; HOLD.
